prompts.L1:

Provided is a jewelry piece that includes an ornament attachment member that is retained at a prescribed position in the longitudinal direction of an elongated body of the jewelry piece. The jewelry piece includes the elongated body that includes a tube formed by a flexible material, multiple magnet pieces that are inserted into the inside of the tube over the entire length of the tube other than both end sections of the tube, and caps that close both ends of the tube, and the ornament attachment member that the elongated body passes through, and that is retained due to the magnetic attraction force exerted by a magnetic substance at a prescribed position in the longitudinal direction of the elongated body. The ornament attachment member is formed by a core body made of a magnetic material, through which the elongated body passes, and by an ornament that is integrally formed with the core body so as to surround the core body.

outputs.L1: Provided is a jewelry piece comprising an ornament attachment member retained at a prescribed position in the longitudinal direction of an elongated body of the jewelry piece. The jewelry piece includes: the elongated body, which comprises a tube formed of a flexible material, a plurality of magnet pieces inserted into the tube along the entire length of the tube except for both end sections thereof, and caps closing both ends of the tube; and the ornament attachment member, through which the elongated body passes and which is retained at the prescribed position in the longitudinal direction of the elongated body by a magnetic attraction force exerted by a magnetic substance. The ornament attachment member comprises a core body made of a magnetic material, through which the elongated body passes, and an ornament integrally formed with the core body so as to surround the core body.
outputs.L2: A jewelry article is described in which an ornament-mounting component is held at a predetermined location along the length of an elongated jewelry body. The jewelry article has an elongated body made up of a tube of flexible material, a plurality of magnet pieces placed inside the tube along substantially its entire length except for the two end portions, and caps that seal the opposite ends of the tube. The ornament-mounting component is penetrated by the elongated body and is kept at the predetermined longitudinal position by magnetic attraction produced by a magnetic substance. This ornament-mounting component includes a core body formed from a magnetic material, with the elongated body passing through the core body, and an ornament formed integrally with the core body so that it surrounds the core body.
outputs.L3:
The jewelry piece includes an elongated flexible body and an ornament attachment member that is retained at a prescribed position along the length of the elongated flexible body. The elongated flexible body is configured to bend or curve easily, allowing the jewelry piece to be worn comfortably and shaped according to the intended use, such as around a wrist, neck, ankle, or other portion of the body.

The elongated flexible body is formed from a flexible tube. A plurality of magnet pieces are accommodated within the flexible tube and are arranged along most of the length of the tube. These magnet pieces provide magnetic attraction along the elongated body while allowing the body to remain flexible. The flexible tube may be made of a soft resin, rubber, elastomer, or other bendable material suitable for use in jewelry.

Both ends of the flexible tube are closed by caps. The caps prevent the magnet pieces from falling out of the tube and also provide finished end portions for the jewelry piece. The caps may be secured to the tube by fitting, adhesion, welding, crimping, or another suitable fastening method.

The ornament attachment member is held at a desired position on the elongated flexible body by magnetic attraction. More specifically, the ornament attachment member is retained through magnetic force generated between the magnet pieces disposed inside the flexible tube and a magnetic substance provided in the ornament attachment member. As a result, the ornament attachment member can be positioned securely while also allowing its position to be adjusted along the length of the elongated body when desired.

The ornament attachment member includes a magnetic core body through which the elongated flexible body passes. The magnetic core body is formed from, or includes, a magnetic substance that is attracted to the magnet pieces inside the flexible tube. An ornament is formed around the magnetic core body, thereby providing the visible decorative portion of the jewelry piece. The ornament may have any suitable decorative shape, design, color, or material, while the magnetic core body functions to retain the ornament attachment member in place on the elongated flexible body.

With this structure, the jewelry piece combines flexibility, adjustability, and decorative appearance. The ornament attachment member can be magnetically retained at a selected position without requiring a mechanical clasp or fixed mounting structure, enabling the wearer to arrange the ornament in a desired location along the elongated body.
outputs.L4:
A jewelry piece includes an elongated body formed as a flexible tube-shaped member. The elongated body is hollow and contains a plurality of magnet pieces arranged along its length. Both ends of the tube-shaped member are closed by end caps so that the magnet pieces remain securely accommodated inside the elongated body.

An ornament attachment member is mounted on the elongated body. The attachment member has an opening through which the elongated body is threaded, allowing the ornament to be moved along the longitudinal direction of the body. The ornament attachment member includes an ornament portion formed around a magnetic core or magnetic member. Because the elongated body contains magnet pieces, the magnetic core of the ornament is attracted to the magnets inside the body.

This magnetic attraction holds the ornament attachment member at a selected position on the elongated body. As a result, the ornament does not freely slide out of place during use, but it can still be repositioned when a user applies sufficient force to move it. The user can therefore adjust the location of the ornament along the jewelry body according to preference, clothing, styling, or the intended appearance of the jewelry.

The structure allows the jewelry piece to be worn in various forms, such as a necklace, bracelet, anklet, or similar decorative accessory. Since the ornament is retained by magnetic attraction rather than by a fixed clasp, hook, or permanent fastener, the design provides both flexibility and adjustability. The ornament can be placed at a desired longitudinal position along the flexible body, enabling a customizable jewelry arrangement while maintaining a secure and decorative appearance.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract describing a jewelry piece with a flexible tubular body containing magnets and a movable ornament attachment retained by magnetic force.
counterfactuals.output: A jewelry article includes a flexible tubular body configured to be worn on a user, the tubular body defining an internal passage and containing a plurality of magnets disposed along at least a portion of the passage. An ornament assembly is movably coupled to the tubular body and includes a decorative element and a magnetic or magnetically attractable attachment portion positioned adjacent the tubular body. Magnetic attraction between the attachment portion and one or more of the magnets retains the ornament assembly on the tubular body while permitting the ornament assembly to be selectively repositioned along the tubular body by sliding or manual movement. The flexible tubular body may form a bracelet, necklace, anklet, ring, or other wearable article, and the magnets may be arranged to maintain the ornament assembly at selected positions without mechanical clasps, openings, or permanent fixation. The jewelry article thereby provides a customizable ornament location while preserving flexibility and wearability.

An ornament member, such as a decorative charm or bead, is provided with a magnetic core and has an opening through which the elongated body passes, allowing the ornament to be magnetically held and positioned on the body. counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a formal technical description for a magnetic jewelry accessory where an ornament can be held at a selected longitudinal position along a necklace or bracelet.
counterfactuals.output:
A magnetic jewelry accessory includes an elongate jewelry member, such as a necklace chain, cord, wire, bracelet band, or similar wearable strand, and an ornament assembly configured to be selectively positioned along a longitudinal extent of the elongate jewelry member. The ornament assembly includes a decorative ornament body and a magnetic retaining arrangement that releasably secures the ornament body at a selected location on the elongate jewelry member without requiring permanent attachment, piercing, knotting, or mechanical deformation of the elongate jewelry member.

In one configuration, the ornament body defines a passage, channel, recess, or guide surface through which, or along which, the elongate jewelry member is received. A first magnetic element is carried by the ornament body, and a second magnetic element or magnetically attractable element is positioned so that magnetic attraction produces a clamping or retaining force on the elongate jewelry member. The magnetic elements may be arranged on opposite sides of the elongate jewelry member, embedded within portions of the ornament body, or provided as a cooperating backing member, collar, sleeve, clasp, cap, or insert.

The magnetic retaining arrangement is selected to provide sufficient holding force to resist unintended sliding of the ornament assembly during normal wear while allowing the wearer to manually reposition the ornament along the elongate jewelry member by applying a longitudinal force greater than the magnetic retention force. Accordingly, the ornament may be moved to a desired longitudinal position and retained there by magnetic frictional engagement, magnetic clamping, or a combination of magnetic attraction and contact pressure between the ornament assembly and the elongate jewelry member.

The ornament body may include decorative features such as a pendant, charm, bead, gemstone setting, emblem, medallion, or ornamental housing. The magnetic elements may comprise permanent magnets, rare-earth magnets, ferromagnetic plates, magnetically attractable inserts, or combinations thereof. The magnetic elements may be concealed within the ornament body to preserve the aesthetic appearance of the jewelry accessory. Contact surfaces engaging the elongate jewelry member may include smooth, coated, resilient, or textured materials to prevent damage to the jewelry member while increasing positional stability.

In use, the wearer places the ornament assembly on the necklace or bracelet and slides or positions the ornament to a selected longitudinal location. Magnetic attraction between the magnetic elements holds the ornament assembly in place relative to the jewelry member. The ornament may subsequently be repositioned by manually overcoming the magnetic holding force, thereby permitting adjustable placement of the ornament without tools and without altering the underlying necklace or bracelet.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention for adjustable jewelry in which a decorative part surrounds a magnetic core and slides along an elongated magnet-containing body but is retained at prescribed positions.
counterfactuals.output:
An adjustable jewelry article includes an elongated body, such as a bracelet band, necklace strand, ring shank, anklet, or brooch bar, that contains one or more magnetic elements along its length. A movable decorative component is mounted on the elongated body and is configured to slide longitudinally relative to it.

The decorative component may include an ornamental outer portion—such as a bead, charm, gem setting, pendant, or decorative sleeve—that surrounds an internal magnetic core. The magnetic core is arranged so that it magnetically interacts with the magnetic elements in the elongated body. This attraction allows the decorative component to be moved by the wearer to different locations while also holding it in place once positioned.

The elongated body may include a series of discrete magnets, magnetic inserts, ferromagnetic regions, or magnetically responsive retaining zones spaced at prescribed intervals. As the decorative component is slid along the body, the magnetic core is drawn into alignment with these retaining zones, creating tactile or positional “stops.” In this way, the decorative component can be selectively retained at predetermined positions without requiring mechanical clasps, threads, pins, or holes.

In one embodiment, the elongated body is a bracelet having a flexible or rigid band with embedded magnets spaced along its length. A decorative slider surrounds the band and includes a central passage through which the band extends. The slider has an outer ornamental housing and an inner magnetic core. The wearer can slide the ornamental housing along the bracelet, and the magnetic core cooperates with the embedded magnets to hold the slider at selected locations.

The invention allows jewelry to be customized in appearance by repositioning one or more decorative elements. Multiple decorative sliders may be used on the same elongated body, and each may be held at a selected prescribed position by magnetic attraction. The magnetic retention provides adjustability while maintaining a clean decorative appearance, since the positioning mechanism can be concealed within the jewelry structure.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
